1803: export function constructWorksiteExecutionHelperArtifact(input: Readonly<WorksiteExecutionHelperArtifactInput>): WorksiteExecutionHelperArtifact {
1804:   if (!isWorksiteExecutionTask(input.task) ||
1805:     !Array.isArray(input.commandResults) || !input.commandResults.every(isCommandResult) ||
1806:     !Array.isArray(input.predicateObservations) ||
1807:     !input.predicateObservations.every(isPredicateObservation) ||
1808:     !Array.isArray(input.worksiteDelta) || !input.worksiteDelta.every(isPathDelta) ||
1809:     !Array.isArray(input.productDelta) || !input.productDelta.every(isPathDelta) ||
1810:     input.productDelta.some((row) => row.matchedTerritoryRef !== null) ||
1811:     input.worksiteDelta.some((row) => row.matchedTerritoryRef !==
1812:       matchingWorksiteTerritoryRef(row.relativePath, input.task.allowedWriteTerritories)) ||
1813:     !Array.isArray(input.protectedBefore) || !Array.isArray(input.protectedAfter) ||
1814:     !input.protectedBefore.every(isWorksiteObservation) ||
1815:     !input.protectedAfter.every(isWorksiteObservation) ||
1816:     input.protectedBefore.length !== worksiteExecutionSources(input.task).length ||
1817:     input.protectedAfter.length !== worksiteExecutionSources(input.task).length ||
1818:     !isAbsolute(input.snapshotRoot) || !nonempty(input.snapshotRef) || !isSha256Digest(input.snapshotDigest) ||
1819:     !Array.isArray(input.snapshotMembers) || !input.snapshotMembers.every((member, ordinal) => isExecutionSnapshotMember(input.task, member, ordinal)) ||
1820:     (input.snapshotMembers.length !== 0 &&
1821:       input.snapshotMembers.length !== worksiteExecutionSources(input.task).length) ||
1822:     (input.snapshotMembers.length === 0 && input.disposition !== "protected_mismatch") ||
1823:     input.snapshotMembers.some((member, ordinal) => {
1824:       const protectedRow = worksiteExecutionSources(input.task)[ordinal];
1825:       return protectedRow === undefined || !executionSnapshotSourceMatches(member, protectedRow) ||
1826:         member.relativePath !== protectedRow.subject.relativePath ||
1827:         member.sourceObservationRef !== protectedRow.observation.observationRef ||
1828:         member.sourceObservationDigest !== protectedRow.observation.observationDigest ||
1829:         member.byteLength !== protectedRow.observation.byteLength ||
1830:         member.digest !== protectedRow.observation.fileDigest;
1831:     }) || input.snapshotDigest !== sha256Canonical(input.snapshotMembers as unknown as JsonValue) ||
1832:     (input.commandResults.length !== 0 && input.commandResults.length !== input.task.commands.length) ||
1833:     (input.predicateObservations.length !== 0 &&
1834:       input.predicateObservations.length !== input.task.outcomePredicates.length) ||
1835:     !((input.commandResults.length === 0 && input.predicateObservations.length === 0) ||
1836:       (input.commandResults.length === input.task.commands.length &&
1837:         input.predicateObservations.length === input.task.outcomePredicates.length)) ||
1838:     (input.disposition === "success" && input.commandResults.length !== input.task.commands.length) ||
1839:     (input.disposition === "success" && input.predicateObservations.length !== input.task.outcomePredicates.length) ||
1840:     (input.disposition === "success" && input.worksiteDelta.some((row) => row.matchedTerritoryRef === null)) ||
1841:     (input.disposition === "success" && input.productDelta.length !== 0) ||
1842:     (input.disposition === "territory_mismatch" && !input.worksiteDelta.some((row) => row.matchedTerritoryRef === null)) ||
1843:     (input.disposition === "product_mismatch" && input.productDelta.length === 0) ||
1844:     input.snapshotRef !== identity(worksiteExecutionIdentityPrefix(input.task, "snapshot"), input.snapshotDigest) ||
1845:     (input.disposition !== "success" && input.disposition !== "protected_mismatch" &&
1846:       input.disposition !== "territory_mismatch" && input.disposition !== "product_mismatch")) {
1847:     throw new TypeError("command helper artifact requires exact task-bound commands and protected observations");
1848:   }
1849:   if (input.commandResults.length === input.task.commands.length) {
1850:     assertWorksiteCommandVectors(input.task, input.commandResults, input.predicateObservations);
1851:   }
1852:   const body = {
1853:     taskRef: input.task.taskRef,
1854:     taskDigest: input.task.taskDigest,
1855:     disposition: input.disposition,
1856:     commandResults: input.commandResults,
1857:     predicateObservations: input.predicateObservations,
1858:     worksiteDelta: input.worksiteDelta,
1859:     productDelta: input.productDelta,
1860:     snapshotRoot: input.snapshotRoot,
1861:     snapshotRef: input.snapshotRef,
1862:     snapshotDigest: input.snapshotDigest,
1863:     snapshotMembers: input.snapshotMembers,
1864:     protectedBefore: input.protectedBefore,
1865:     protectedAfter: input.protectedAfter,
1866:   };
1867:   const artifactDigest = sha256Canonical(body as unknown as JsonValue);
1868:   return deepFreeze({
1869:     kind: input.task.kind === "worksite_command_forward_task" ? "worksite_command_forward_helper_artifact" as const
1870:       : input.task.kind === "worksite_command_execution_task" ? "worksite_command_helper_artifact" as const : "worksite_revision_command_helper_artifact" as const,
1871:     schemaVersion: SCHEMA_VERSION,

1874:     ...body,
1875:   }) as WorksiteExecutionHelperArtifact;
1876: }

1881: ): value is WorksiteExecutionHelperArtifact {
1882:   if (!isRecord(value) || !exactKeys(value, [
1883:     "artifactDigest", "artifactRef", "commandResults", "disposition", "kind", "predicateObservations",
1884:     "productDelta", "protectedAfter", "protectedBefore", "schemaVersion", "taskDigest", "taskRef",
1885:     "snapshotDigest", "snapshotMembers", "snapshotRef", "snapshotRoot", "worksiteDelta",
1886:   ]) || value.kind !== (task.kind === "worksite_command_forward_task" ? "worksite_command_forward_helper_artifact"
1887:     : task.kind === "worksite_command_execution_task" ? "worksite_command_helper_artifact" : "worksite_revision_command_helper_artifact") || value.schemaVersion !== SCHEMA_VERSION ||
1888:     value.taskRef !== task.taskRef || value.taskDigest !== task.taskDigest ||
1889:     !isSha256Digest(value.artifactDigest) || !nonempty(value.artifactRef)) return false;
1890:   try {
1891:     return same(value, constructWorksiteExecutionHelperArtifact({
1892:       task,
1893:       disposition: value.disposition as "product_mismatch" | "protected_mismatch" | "success" | "territory_mismatch",

1896:       worksiteDelta: value.worksiteDelta as readonly WorksitePathDelta[],
1897:       productDelta: value.productDelta as readonly WorksitePathDelta[],
1898:       snapshotRoot: value.snapshotRoot as string,
1899:       snapshotRef: value.snapshotRef as string,
1900:       snapshotDigest: value.snapshotDigest as Sha256Digest,
1901:       snapshotMembers: value.snapshotMembers as readonly WorksiteExecutionSnapshotMember[],
1902:       protectedBefore: value.protectedBefore as readonly WorksiteObservation[],

303: ### Observed existing-worksite source (QUAL056-C2-OBSERVED01; T-287 default library)
304: 
305: An ordinary root C2 invocation may explicitly select an observed existing
306: worksite as its source. No construction/native author Result is asserted by
307: this arm. `constructObservedWorksiteCommandExecutionTask` takes current
308: `A`/`W`/direct grant, a nonempty unique ordered set of actual file subjects and
309: observations, and the unchanged command/predicate/write-territory declarations.
310: It derives member and source-set identities and retains one
311: `protectedObservations` vector. The closed `sourceObservedInput` discriminator
312: replaces construction/native ancestry only for this arm. It is neither a
313: qualification-domain source nor a claim that the selected files are an
314: adequate or complete verifier input; that remains the selecting consumer's duty.
315: 
316: The existing root C2 Program/GraphFunction admits this exact input with
317: `source:none`. That means no predecessor runtime Result; it does not waive file,
318: authority, grant or currentness evidence. The owning invocation admission must
319: bind the exact task digest, C2 contract and current workspace. The pre-effect
320: owner reidentifies that actual root input and current binding/grant, refuses
321: later admitted mutations or failed native writes affecting selected paths, and
322: retains the existing physical O1 checks before manifests/snapshot/dispatch.
323: A source-set digest or a caller-created observation alone grants no effect.
324: Changed files, foreign bindings, stale/crossed input or counterfeit mixed-source
325: carriers refuse. The default-library Testing wrapper may additionally invoke this
326: arm as a child under `T287_DEFAULT_GOVERNANCE_LIBRARY_DESIGN.md`: its owned
327: preparation observes the selected files; the exact advancing Result/judgment/route
328: joins the current parent occurrence, original grant and fixed C2 child before
329: admission. Currentness extends from that preparation acquisition cut through
330: the held pre-effect prefix and physical O1. Replay reconstructs the historical
331: preparation/observation relation without inventing an author or rereading the
332: current filesystem. The original root binding is unchanged. C1/C3, native,
333: reacquisition, revision and forward source laws are unchanged.
334: 
335: The snapshot helper consumes the same selected source rows and retains the
336: same source/member/task/result coordinates. Original worksite inputs and
337: installed Products remain protected. When an existing build script overwrites
338: seed files, an explicit recipe copies its selected snapshot inputs into a
339: different declared writable evidence subtree and runs there; protected input
340: paths do not become writable. Commands, environments, reports, budgets and
341: semantic interpretation remain declared consumer data.
342: 
343: The selected `F_P worker_executes` implementation, exact one-Bash helper call,
344: compact acknowledgment, actual command/report/protected-file observation,
345: failure behavior, result admission and replay remain unchanged. There is no
346: new executor, native author, C1 result, private event, Public operation or
347: qualification verdict. QUAL-056's recipe/lint/report-conservation and F11
348: material join remain separate prerequisites.
